routes.name: Bangladesh visa application (online MRV form)
routes.summary: The Department of Immigration and Passports portal lets you fill in the visa form online for a new visa, extension, no-visa-required (NVR) or visa on arrival (OAV). You then print it and take it to a Bangladesh mission or visa office. No online payment.

other: Eligibility, visa categories, fees and stay lengths were not confirmed. The main immigration site (dip.gov.bd) failed its certificate check and the foreign ministry pages did not list visa rules.
Check the portal's supported countries list and the nearest Bangladesh mission before you apply.

steps: Fill in and submit the online form at visa.gov.bd.
Take it with your documents and the visa fee to the nearest visa office or Bangladesh mission.
